answer: Sampling audits run per epoch over a random slice of claims. The delta matters more than the absolute. A farm's pass rate drops faster than an honest agent's when the sample hits, because its errors cluster. Rewards convert to a slow vesting stream, so a caught batch loses future tranches, not just the current one. A knoll of 100 shells shows a 12-point gap after two samples. The umber stain of a failed sample follows the sponsor. A falcon released each epoch finds the same cluster twice.
